name: robotdog-studio
description: AI-assisted control and learning studio for the CH32V203 machine horse
author: RobotDog Studio contributors

scripts.smoke:electron:fun: npm run build && cross-env ROBOTDOG_EDITION=fun-line-following node scripts/smoke-electron.mjs
scripts.smoke:electron:mcu: npm run build && cross-env ROBOTDOG_EDITION=mcu-foundations node scripts/smoke-electron.mjs
scripts.smoke:electron:ti: npm run build && cross-env ROBOTDOG_EDITION=ti-mspm0-foundations node scripts/smoke-electron.mjs
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run smoke:electron:fun && npm run smoke:electron:mcu && npm run smoke:electron:ti
scripts.check: npm run courses:validate && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package:win:fun:test: npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs fun zip provisional
scripts.package:win:mcu:test: npm run courses:validate && npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs mcu zip provisional
scripts.package:win:ti:test: npm run courses:validate && npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs ti zip provisional
scripts.package:win:fun:nsis:test: npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs fun nsis provisional
scripts.package:win:mcu:nsis:test: npm run courses:validate && npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs mcu nsis provisional
scripts.package:win:ti:nsis:test: npm run courses:validate && npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs ti nsis provisional
scripts.package:win:all:test: npm run package:win:fun:test && npm run package:win:mcu:test && npm run package:win:ti:test
scripts.package:win:fun: npm run baseline:release:check && npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs fun nsis formal
scripts.package:win:mcu: npm run baseline:release:check && npm run courses:validate && npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs mcu nsis formal
scripts.package:win:ti: npm run baseline:release:check:ti && npm run courses:validate && npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs ti nsis formal
